adjudications.reason: Draft goal is unambiguously heat-network feed-in. Author acknowledges deep geothermal direct heat earlier and explicitly labels this scenario electrical. The subsequent therefore-link to shallow heat pumps is troubling, but a hypothetical-option reading remains possible. Do not assert proven target misdescription.

The below-one assertion is not established by the stated lower bound, but this alone is missing support rather than a proved false result. The sentence does not explicitly name 2.8%as an exact break-even threshold or state every larger cost suffices. Higher actual costs can satisfy both >2.8%and below 1. A 3%counterexample refutes a universal implication, not necessarily the author’s actual project assumption. Preserve as unresolved unless an explicit sufficient-threshold assertion or actual share is found.
adjudications.alternative_test: With the author’s reported 1.592, raw delivery cost 100%of raw-heat price gives 1.592/2=0.796<1 and meets the lower bound. With corrected 1.32136,50%of raw heat gives 0.88091<1. These examples are logical rescues, not empirical project-cost estimates.

adjudications.reason: Author explicitly states national households, first-half 2023, average 33.00. Same-period primary Destatis average 42.29(including price-brake relief)and adjacent gas 12.26 match period. Neither household consumption-band totals nor national non-household average supports 33.00. Special operator tariff or different year cannot rescue this descriptive sentence, but actual industrial applicability remains open.

Physical 13 uses 313.15 Kfor 50 C, while 50 C=323.15 K. This is another small input inconsistency; no additional record requested or broad thermodynamic claim adjudicated.
